name: Gaussian Rasterization via OpenGL Geometry Shader
aliases: OpenGL Geometry Shader Rasterization for 3D Gaussians
definition: Renders 3D Gaussian splats as screen-space quads using a vertex-geometry-fragment shader pipeline, leveraging the fixed-function OpenGL rasterizer instead of a software CUDA implementation.
summary: Gaussian Rasterization via OpenGL Geometry Shader renders 3D Gaussians as screen-space quads using the fixed-function OpenGL rasterizer, achieving 5-10x speedup over software CUDA rasterization by offloading clipping and blending to hardware.
